questions.subject: NP IV
questions.stem: Nurses meet a senator's staff to push for a bill raising nurses' pay. This is:
questions.rationale: Lobbying directs efforts at officials to influence legislation; advocacy raises and publicizes an issue.
questions.source: Udan, Healthcare Ethics (2023), Ch. 8 Lobbying and advocating (PDF p. 174)
questions.quote: Lobbying is the process of directing one's efforts toward individuals in positions of authority

questions.subject: NP I
questions.stem: A nurse runs a social media campaign to raise awareness of dengue prevention. This is:
questions.rationale: Advocacy promotes a cause and raises awareness in a community; lobbying targets officials to pass laws.
questions.source: Udan, Healthcare Ethics (2023), Ch. 8 Lobbying and advocating (PDF p. 174)
questions.quote: To advocate is to raise and publicize an issue within a community

questions.subject: NP V
questions.stem: In what year did the ICN first adopt an international code of ethics for nurses?
questions.rationale: The ICN first adopted its Code of Ethics for Nurses in 1953; it has been revised several times since.
questions.source: Udan, Healthcare Ethics (2023), Ch. 8 ICN Code of Ethics (PDF p. 177)
questions.quote: An international code of ethics for nurses was first adopted by the International Council of Nurses (ICN) in 1953.

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: According to the ICN Code, nursing care is unrestricted by considerations of:
questions.rationale: Nursing care respects human rights and is unrestricted by age, color, creed, culture, gender, nationality, politics or status.
questions.source: Udan, Healthcare Ethics (2023), Ch. 8 ICN Code of Ethics (PDF p. 177)
questions.quote: Nursing care is respectful of and unrestricted by considerations of age, color, creed, culture, disability or illness, gender

questions.subject: NP IV
questions.stem: Under the ICN Code, the nurse maintains competence through:
questions.rationale: The nurse carries responsibility for practice and for maintaining competence by continual learning.
questions.source: Udan, Healthcare Ethics (2023), Ch. 8 Nurses and practice (PDF p. 177)
questions.quote: for maintaining competence by continual learning

questions.subject: NP IV
questions.stem: A nurse sees a co-worker endanger a patient. Under the ICN Code, she should:
options: Wait for the shift to end
questions.rationale: The nurse takes appropriate action to safeguard people when their health is endangered by a co-worker or anyone else.
questions.source: Udan, Healthcare Ethics (2023), Ch. 8 Nurses and co-workers (PDF p. 178)
questions.quote: The nurse takes appropriate action to safeguard individuals, families and communities when their health is endangered by a co-worker

questions.subject: NP V
questions.stem: Under the Code of Ethics for Filipino RNs, when health can no longer be preserved, the nurse's obligation is to:
questions.rationale: The preamble states that when promotion, prevention, alleviation and restoration are not possible, assisting toward a peaceful death is the nurse's obligation.
questions.source: Udan, Healthcare Ethics (2023), Ch. 8 Code of Ethics for RNs, Art. I (PDF p. 182)
questions.quote: when the foregoing are not possible, assistance towards a peaceful death shall be his/her obligation

questions.subject: NP I
questions.stem: Under the Code of Ethics for Filipino RNs, personal information acquired in giving care shall be:
questions.rationale: Article II: personal information acquired in giving nursing care is held in strict confidence.
questions.source: Udan, Healthcare Ethics (2023), Ch. 8 Code of Ethics for RNs, Art. II (PDF p. 182)
questions.quote: Personal information acquired in the process of giving nursing care shall be held in strict confidence.

questions.subject: NP IV
questions.stem: Which body accredits nursing specialty certification programs of the Board of Nursing?
questions.rationale: Professional programs for specialty certification by the BON are accredited through the NSCC.
questions.source: Udan, Healthcare Ethics (2023), Ch. 8 Code of Ethics for RNs, Sec. 5 (PDF p. 182)
questions.quote: accredited t}yough the Nursing Specialty Certification Council (NSCC)

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: Under the Code of Ethics for Filipino RNs, the nurse is the patient's:
questions.rationale: Registered nurses are advocates of patients and take steps to safeguard their rights and privileges.
questions.source: Udan, Healthcare Ethics (2023), Ch. 8 Code of Ethics for RNs, Sec. 8 (PDF p. 183)
questions.quote: Registered Nurses are the advocates of the patients

questions.subject: NP III
questions.stem: A grateful patient's family offers a nurse an envelope of cash. Per the Code of Ethics, she should:
questions.rationale: Nurses decline any gift, favor or hospitality that might be interpreted as capitalizing on patients.
questions.source: Udan, Healthcare Ethics (2023), Ch. 8 Code of Ethics for RNs, Sec. 11 (PDF p. 183)
questions.quote: Decline any gift, favor or hospitality which might be interpreted as capitalizing on patients.

questions.subject: NP III
questions.stem: A private-duty nurse pays a clinic aide a fee for every patient referred to her. This violates the Code because nurses must not:
questions.rationale: Nurses must not demand or receive commissions or fees for referring or recommending patients.
questions.source: Udan, Healthcare Ethics (2023), Ch. 8 Code of Ethics for RNs, Sec. 11 (PDF p. 183)
questions.quote: Not demand and receive any commission, fee or other compensations to the one referring or recommending a patient

questions.subject: NP IV
questions.stem: A nurse is asked to appear in a revealing uniform for a product advertisement. Per the Code, she should:
questions.rationale: Nurses must not allow themselves to be used in advertisements that demean the profession (indecent exposure, dress code violations).
questions.source: Udan, Healthcare Ethics (2023), Ch. 8 Code of Ethics for RNs, Sec. 11 (PDF p. 183)
questions.quote: Not allow themselves to be used in advertisement that should demean the image of the profession

questions.subject: NP V
questions.stem: A nurse makes unfair remarks to patients about a doctor's competence. Under the Code, this is:
questions.rationale: Nurses honor the reputation of other professions and refrain from unfair, unwarranted comments on their competence.
questions.source: Udan, Healthcare Ethics (2023), Ch. 8 Code of Ethics for RNs, Sec. 13 (PDF p. 184)
questions.quote: refrain from making unfair and unwarranted comments or criticisms on their competence

questions.subject: NP I
questions.stem: Under the Code, a nurse's duty to society includes:
questions.rationale: Nurses must know community health resources and take active roles in primary health care.
questions.source: Udan, Healthcare Ethics (2023), Ch. 8 Code of Ethics for RNs, Sec. 15 (PDF p. 184)
questions.quote: take active roles in primary health care

questions.subject: NP IV
questions.stem: Which organization does the Code require Filipino RNs to be members of?
questions.rationale: Registered nurses must be members of the Accredited Professional Organization, the PNA.
questions.source: Udan, Healthcare Ethics (2023), Ch. 8 Code of Ethics for RNs, Sec. 17 (PDF p. 185)
questions.quote: Be members of the Accredited Professional Organization (PNA).

questions.subject: NP IV
questions.stem: Under the Code, patients' records may be released only to:
questions.rationale: Records are available only to those professionally and directly involved in care, and when required by law.
questions.source: Udan, Healthcare Ethics (2023), Ch. 8 Code of Ethics for RNs, Sec. 5 (PDF p. 183)
questions.quote: Ensure that patients' records shall be available only if they are to be issued to those who are professionally and directly involved in their care
